name: Keyboard
summary: A fast, bright sitcom on a giant laptop keyboard, with a wall-size dashboard behind the cast that carries jokes and numbers.

shotTypes.lead-seated: the lead full body seated on the keys
shotTypes.lead-low: the lead from a low angle
shotTypes.lead-profile: the lead in a tight three-quarter profile
shotTypes.lead-reach: the lead reaching toward the agents
shotTypes.lead-wide: the lead small, low in frame, the screen above
shotTypes.cu: an agent close, filling the width
shotTypes.full: an agent full body with arms and feet
shotTypes.side: an agent three-quarter with the city behind
shotTypes.wide: both at the frame edges, the screen between them
shotTypes.high: a high angle over the keyboard
shotTypes.end: the extra-wide of the whole board
shotTypes.board: the dashboard as the subject, cards readable, the cast small at the bottom corners
shotTypes.low: the camera at key level: big keys in front, the screen above (often just before the end)
shotTypes.lead-city: the lead with the night city behind him (the reverse angle, dashboard out of frame)
shotTypes.top: straight down over the keys and the lead

spec.Set: A giant laptop: the cast on the keys, a wall-size dashboard of agent cards behind, a night city around
spec.Screen: Carries jokes and callbacks: cards whose lines change with the story (counters, typed lines)
spec.Render look: Flat-shaded faceted low poly, saturated purple and orange, bloom
spec.Lens and focus: Medium lenses (26 to 30 degrees), background readable
spec.Camera motion: Mostly locked off with small drifts; the motion comes from the characters
spec.Cutting: About 30 shots a minute, a dozen camera set-ups
spec.Captions: White bold sans, no box, upper middle
spec.Sound: A light music bed carved under the voices, small effects
spec.Best for: Stories about tools and building, jokes that are numbers on a screen; more work per episode

night-city.name: Night city
night-city.summary: The giant laptop at night: a starry sky over a lit skyline all around, a warm key on the cast, the dashboard glowing blue.

window-ledge.name: Window ledge
window-ledge.summary: High above the city at night: the cast stands on a dark window sill, a cross-framed window onto stars and lit towers, big warm lamps blurred along the top, the agent dashboard glowing along the foot of the frame.
